known_differences: Native Stitch output invents a generic dashboard and alters lower-section copy; original generated HTML and thumbnail screenshots are preserved separately, and the hosted draft uses dated official media and content.
The Stitch request specified MOBILE, but the returned screen is labeled DESKTOP and places a 390px phone design on a 2560px canvas; it is not a validated mobile export.

The public draft approximates official layout; announcement rotation, complete mega menus, customer-story switching, assistant input, Atlas visual updates, and other dynamic behavior are incomplete. Non-default customer logo controls lead to the official story index rather than switching local content.
Responsive full-page visual side-by-side comparison with the current official site remains pending, so exact parity is unverified.
